description: This source file implements a filter class 'XFilterDrop' and associated functions to handle the 'X-Sendfile' header in a web server context, specifically for the lighttpd server. The code drops incoming request content, manages response headers, and injects file content into the response for X-Sendfile support.

classes.name: XFilterDrop
classes.description: A filter class that drops all incoming request data and signals the server to continue processing.

methods.name: XFilterDrop:new
methods.description: Creates a new instance of XFilterDrop.

methods.name: XFilterDrop:handle
methods.description: Handles incoming request data by dropping it and marking the input as closed.
